dimensions.name: Sentiment

labels.name: Positive
labels.definition: The text expresses a positive sentiment, approval, satisfaction, happiness, or optimism.

labels.name: Neutral
labels.definition: The text is factual, objective, or does not express clear positive or negative sentiment.

labels.name: Negative
labels.definition: The text expresses a negative sentiment, disapproval, dissatisfaction, frustration, or pessimism.
examples: I'm very disappointed with the service.

dimensions.instructions: Focus on the overall sentiment of the text. If mixed, choose the dominant sentiment.
